authentication.purpose: Authenticate producer evidence before 32 fresh whole-call benchmark workers

rawReport.coldDefinition: First second-batch call in a fresh process after checked-session setup and the independent V1 outcome control; not the first kernel operation.
rawReport.order: ABBA: baseline,candidate,candidate,baseline for each size/query; each worker is a new detached process.
rawReport.scope: Actual original and candidate public RunDag calls; complete import/validation/checking cost included.

normalization: All original summary fields and all32 raw worker records are preserved. The report SHA256 authenticates the original JSON in the Actions artifact; this normalized file has different serialization and does not claim that byte digest.

performanceReview.decision: Promote the bounded T03b semantic migration with an explicit reviewed correctness tradeoff; do not qualify it for performance or release. D remains OPEN.
performanceReview.basis: All own-source functional/official/generated/proof/provider controls and 384 independent V1-validated benchmark calls pass. Fresh checked-session ownership is required to establish the direct-path and owner-identity invariants.
performanceReview.independentReview: A separate read-only review recomputed every summary and median from all 32 worker records, checked exact ABBA order, both source/kernel digests, V1 outcomes and fixed resources, and reached the same correctness-only promotion decision.
performanceReview.explanation: Owned-constant cold overhead is 2.3775775ms at32 owners and2.3327325ms at128; added incremental retained heap is260712/262272 bytes. These observations support a bounded correctness tradeoff at the two tested sizes, not an asymptotic theorem. Unknown/trivial/ill-typed overheads remain recorded performance debt, not relabeled as speedups or dismissed as noise.
performanceReview.repetitions: One full unchanged driver run for this pair; no selected subsets, favorable-sample reruns or threshold changes.
performanceReview.statisticalLimit: Two fresh processes per revision per query/size, nine warm calls each. Pooled18-call median is the published driver statistic; the18 calls are not18 independent process replications. Cold is the first second-batch call after setup and V1 control. All warmups and worker-level observations remain in the raw report. In128-owner owned-constant, pooled warm median grows5.15%, whereas median of process medians grows16.64%; neither process nor aggregation is dropped. The cost is not proved unavoidable and remains optimization work.
